name: School-Year ZooTeens (Winter Teen Conservation Outreach Internship)
org: Zoo New England, Franklin Park Zoo
what_you_do: You learn to plan and run a 30-minute conservation program. It is for elementary school students. Then you work weekend shifts at the zoo. You guide guests and help care for turtles and rabbits.
who_can_apply: Teens 14 to 19 years old at the start of the internship, with a sincere interest in wildlife, education and environmental justice. About 6 to 8 interns are accepted.
duration: 30 hours of weekend and February vacation week shifts, plus workshops
deadline_text: Applications for the Winter Teen Conservation Outreach Internship are due December 9, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application by December 9. Some applicants are invited to an in-person group interview. Email Ana Shapiro, Youth Programs Manager, at ashapiro@zoonewengland.org (no phone calls).
notes: Unpaid, so the work permit question is left open. Spring and summer teen internships are also planned; the page links a calendar of internship periods. The fall internship application is closed.
